title: nf-codonyat samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet CSV file used by nf-codonyat

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces or special characters except - and _

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

sam.errorMessage: SAM file must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.sam'
